independent_GCP_pass_conditions: Digitize the exact cartographic object symbol/physical landmark anchor in 1859 MNL photo, not a generalized settlement hatch or name
Identify same individual object in independent dated historic source and modern audited point/vertex coordinates
Review local image distortion, potential scan/cut folds, and mapping projection and point error
Use at least four non-collinear and geographically distributed verified GCPs for first-order affine pilot (three algebraic minimum insufficient for robust validation); retain separate holdouts
Report per-point provenance, residuals, cross-validation, units, transformation type and spatial validity; holdout error must be suitable for map scale
Only after valid source photo map units, consider manual per-way boundary tracing and separate legal corroboration
